hypothesis: Running OLMoE batch-1 decode on the GPU (dense weights resident in VRAM, 992 of the 1024 int8 experts resident with the default reserve and the rest uploaded on demand, router resolved on the device) is bandwidth-bound on VRAM instead of DRAM, so tokens/s rises several-fold with the same logits up to float summation order.
